title: Vulnerabilities in F&F Filipowski mH-DEVELOPER devices
content_md: CERT Polska has received a report about 7 vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-82928 to CVE-2026-82930 and CVE-2026-82932, CVE-2026-82933, CVE-2026-82935 and CVE-2026-82936) found in F&F Filipowski mH-DEVELOPER devices. Article Link: Vulnerabilities in F&F Filipowski mH-DEVELOPER devices | CERT Polska
